heightDefinition: Uniform source outsole-to-hair/hood envelope; anatomical scalp under hood not invented.
shoulderDefinition: Measured fitted shoulder-joint span; outer garment envelope recorded separately.

surfaceSplit.method: Source-hash-defined surface seam split; removed only mixed cloak/body bridge faces; closed new bounded body loops using adjacent original UVs

innerCapeRefinement.method: Local original inner-shell edge subdivision; original corner positions and UVs preserved, new corners interpolate source UV and continuous existing cape weights. Outer silhouette and helper bind transforms unchanged.

capeRepair.method: Reviewed source-index cape/body ownership; localized fused-contact seam split, body lining and source-UV sampling; original ragged cape hem retained.
capeRepair.visualStatus: Focused offline production-runtime poses were visually reviewed for source appearance, locomotion, weapon grips, mounted composition and death. This is not browser/GPU/manual play acceptance or a claim of continuous collision-free cloth; final real-LOD matrix evidence is recorded separately.

lod1.method: Reduced-LOD posterior cape inner shell reconstructed from decimated matching outer topology/skin; original inner UVs sampled onto inward copies. LOD0 unchanged.

lod2.method: Reduced-LOD posterior cape inner shell reconstructed from decimated matching outer topology/skin; original inner UVs sampled onto inward copies. LOD0 unchanged.

rangedGripCalibration.method: Opposite anatomical shaft polarity from sword; unchanged measured palm center and normal.
rangedGripCalibration.review: Production held pilum phase .28 front/side/rear and preserved release event.

construction.method: Independent Nordic cap-connected safe branch at37 phases; periodic Gaussian smoothing and uniform majorant; C2 periodic cubic

validation.sampling: 480 Hz plus .10,.25,.60,.65; finite temporal sampling, exported GLB must be independently rechecked

geometryRevalidation.method: Original Nordic periodic curve preserved; 32 inspected inner-shell faces locally subdivided with continuous cape weights; outer geometry, source corners and rig unchanged
geometryRevalidation.scope: Selected cape/lower-leg triangle contacts at finite samples; visual review separately required
